name: opportunity-first-discovery
purpose: Acceptance scenarios for opportunity ranking before people/contact research. Fixture judgments are expected behavior, not proof of native skill activation or live source truth.

candidate_evidence: Head of Product at Mobius Logic AI since 2024; enterprise product portfolio, four direct-report product managers, AI opportunity evaluation/prioritization and product operating model.
Senior Product Manager at University of Chicago from 2020 to 2023; enterprise system modernization, workflows and platform strategy.

The supplied profile does not establish production AI workflow outcomes, deep online-program operations, large engineering-organization ownership, enterprise-architecture depth, or M&A integration leadership.

opportunities.title: Senior Director, Digital and AI Tech Product Management
opportunities.evidence: Official Risepoint Workday listing: US remote; owns digital/AI product strategy, workflow transformation, product roadmap, discovery-to-delivery, and cross-functional implementation. Must-have evidence includes 8+ years technology product management, university systems/process knowledge, and recent AI-led product/workflow transformation with changed workflows and outcomes. No direct reports in initial year.

opportunities.title: VP, AI Transformation & Enterprise Architecture
opportunities.evidence: Official Risepoint Workday listing: US remote; enterprise AI strategy and architecture, production AI platforms, engineering leadership, integrations and M&A; requires 15+ years progressive technology leadership including large-scale engineering organizations, demonstrated production AI products/platforms, architecture expertise, and M&A/integration experience.

explanation_must_include: The Senior Director product role is the stronger relative fit because product leadership, enterprise workflow/platform experience, and higher-education experience connect more directly to its actual scope.

The product role remains a qualification HOLD unless the candidate can evidence the mandatory recent AI-led workflow transformation outcomes and required university-system knowledge; do not invent either.
The VP role ranks lower because central engineering-organization, enterprise-architecture, production-AI-platform, and M&A requirements are not established by the profile.
Contact routes, named executives, private history, and contact readiness are not inputs to this opportunity ranking.
must_not: Rank the VP role higher only because its title is more senior.
Treat the first role's missing contact route as a reason to lower its opportunity quality.
Claim either job is currently accepting applications without current status evidence.

candidate_evidence: Tucson-based Head of Product with enterprise product and AI portfolio experience.
Senior Product Manager at University of Chicago; enterprise systems modernization and workflow/platform strategy.
Profile does not establish five years of managerial experience, research administration/funding ownership, or the University's exact budget-administration depth.

opportunities.title: Senior Director, CAIO Office and Institutes
opportunities.evidence: Posting describes senior administrative, strategic and operational leadership for the CAIO and affiliated ORAI/AI2S functions; institutional AI planning; research development; budgets/resources; cross-campus partnerships; performance measures and executive reporting. It names David Ebert as CAIO and Rudy Salcido as candidate contact. Posting says minimum 9 years related experience including 5 years managerial experience.
opportunities.organization_evidence: Official ORAI directory says David Ebert leads ORAI/AI2S and sets institutional AI/data-science strategy; official roadmap covers research, education, operations and innovation.

opportunities.title: AI Roadmap implementation and campus AI adoption
opportunities.evidence: Official roadmap describes campus AI platform, responsible use, staff workflow adoption and fluency. This is organizational context, not an advertised external role; the AI Leadership Collaborative's cohort participation is limited to university faculty/staff and is not itself an eligible external opening.

must_keep_org_structure: Chief AI and Data Science Officer / ORAI leadership
Arizona Institute for AI and Society
cross-campus research, academic, operations and finance partners
must_state: The posted Senior Director role is direct hiring; the roadmap is strategic context, not another vacancy.
Candidate's higher-education modernization and AI/product leadership are relevant, but five years of managerial experience is not established and must remain a mandatory qualification HOLD.
A strategic contribution must be bounded and complementary to the CAIO/ORAI leadership and not presented as an invented role.
must_not: Infer research administration or five years of management from titles alone.
Treat the faculty/staff AI cohort as an external job opportunity.

cases.scenario: An organization has a current, first-party AI workflow initiative with measured operational goals, executive sponsorship and business-unit owners, but no advertised leadership vacancy.

must_not: equate an AI announcement alone with a career opportunity
require a verified email before ranking the opportunity

cases.scenario: Two sourced opportunities have equal fit, need, contribution scope, timing, geography, and evidence quality. The higher-ranked strategic prospect has no verified person-specific route; the other has a publicly listed direct work route.

must_not: demote a strong opportunity because of route availability
claim contact-ready when its route or history gate fails

cases.scenario: A strong opportunity is ranked and a suitable executive is identified, but no person-specific route, private-history check, or independent human review is available.

must_not: let opportunity quality override governance gates

cases.scenario: A direct-hiring role has strong organizational need and appealing scope, but at least one mandatory qualification is explicitly unsupported or established unmet by the supplied profile.

expected.candidate_feasibility: lowered or held according to whether evidence is NOT_MET or NOT_EVIDENCED
expected.ranking: must account for candidate feasibility and actual eligibility
must_not: treat unknown evidence as proof of eligibility
confuse role quality with candidate feasibility

cases.scenario: Initial rankings are made before people research. Leadership discovery finds sourced new facts about an incumbent's remit and a distinct unowned operating responsibility; it also finds a public route for a lower-ranked opportunity.

expected.rank_revision: permitted only if organizational/role evidence materially changes comparative need, scope, timing, authority, incumbency, or candidate feasibility
must_not: revise rank solely because a person is easier to reach
use novelty or route availability as opportunity evidence
